mapper.select: select d.ID_ as detail_id, d.PROC_INST_ID_ as process_instance_id, d.ACT_INST_ID_ as activity_instance_id, d.TASK_ID_ as task_id, d.NAME_ as variable_name, d.REV_ as revision, d.VAR_TYPE_ as variable_type_name, d.TIME_ as submitted_at, d.TYPE_ as detail_type, d.BYTEARRAY_ID_ as byte_array_id, case when d.TEXT_ is null then 0 else 1 end as text_present, case when d.TEXT2_ is null then 0 else 1 end as text2_present, octet_length(d.TEXT_) as text_bytes, case when b.ID_ is null then 0 else 1 end as byte_array_present, case when b.BYTES_ is null then 0 else 1 end as byte_array_body_present, octet_length(b.BYTES_) as stored_bytes from ACT_HI_DETAIL d left join ACT_GE_BYTEARRAY b on b.ID_ = d.BYTEARRAY_ID_ where d.PROC_INST_ID_ = #{processInstanceId} and d.NAME_ = #{variableName} order by d.TIME_, d.REV_, d.ID_ limit #{rowLimit}
